blocks.text: MARAMAG, Bukidnon — Sugarcane planters across Bukidnon welcomed the opening of quedan trading last Friday, with millgate prices reaching a favorable P2,600 per bag of raw sugar despite threats of red-striped soft scale insect (RSSI) infestation and rising labor and hauling costs. Quedan trading involves negotiable warehouse receipts that prove ownership of a specific volume of sugar stored in a mill or bonded warehouse. Almeric Batoy, president of the San Roque Backyard Raiser and Sugarcane Farmers Association (SRBRSFA), said the better millgate price was a welcome relief to many farmers as they began harvesting and selling their produce. “The first quedan […]...
